name: Expanded Spell List
description:
3rd-level Fathomless feature

The Fathomless lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

Fathomless Expanded Spells

Level 1st: create or destroy water, thunderwave

Level 2nd: gust of wind, silence

Level 3rd: lightning bolt, sleet storm

Level 4th: control water, summon elemental (water only; a spell in chapter 3)

Level 5th: Bigby’s hand (appears as a tentacle), cone of cold
